BASE06_agentic_semantic_3490cd5f.query_text: What is the total number of stop events and average stop events per journey for each line?
BASE06_agentic_semantic_3490cd5f.final_sparql:
PREFIX tro: <http://example.org/ontology/transport#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?lineAbbreviation (SUM(?stopEventsPerJourney) AS ?totalStopEvents) (AVG(?stopEventsPerJourney) AS ?avgStopEventsPerJourney)
WHERE {
  # Get all trips with their lines
  ?trip a tro:Trip .
  ?trip tro:line ?line .
  ?trip tro:abbreviation ?tripAbbreviation .
  
  # Get line abbreviation
  ?line tro:abbreviation ?lineAbbreviation .
  
  # Count stop events per journey
  {
    SELECT ?trip (COUNT(?stopEvent) AS ?stopEventsPerJourney)
    WHERE {
      ?stopEvent a tro:StopEvent .
      ?stopEvent tro:journey ?trip .
    }
    GROUP BY ?trip
  }
}
GROUP BY ?lineAbbreviation
ORDER BY ?lineAbbreviation

BASE08_agentic_semantic_39f5862e.query_text: Show the top 10 stations with the most journeys.
BASE08_agentic_semantic_39f5862e.final_sparql:
PREFIX tro: <http://example.org/ontology/transport#>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

SELECT ?stationName (COUNT(?journey) AS ?journeyCount) WHERE {
  ?stopEvent a tro:StopEvent .
  ?stopEvent tro:station ?station .
  ?stopEvent tro:journey ?journey .
  ?station foaf:name ?stationName .
}
GROUP BY ?stationName
ORDER BY DESC(?journeyCount)
LIMIT 10

    ?stopTime tro:station ?stop .
    ?stopTime tro:journey ?trip .
    OPTIONAL { ?stop foaf:name ?stopName }

SELECT ?deposit ?depositName (SUM(?extractedCrude) AS ?totalExtractedCrude)
WHERE {
  ?depositOutput eno:extractedCrude ?extractedCrude ;
                  eno:outputForDeposit ?deposit .
  ?deposit eno:designation ?depositName .
}

ORDER BY DESC(?totalExtractedCrude)

SELECT ?basicModule ?basicModuleLabel ?advancedModule ?advancedModuleLabel ?instructor ?division ?divisionLabel WHERE {

  ?basicModule a eduo:BasicModule .

  ?advancedModule a eduo:AdvancedModule .

  ?division eduo:label ?divisionLabel .
